overview: Thicket Cavern Mouths is the surface threshold leading into Netherbian tunnels. Cavern entrances, burrow openings, and corrupted dens mark the transition from forest to subterranean hive.
history: Cavern mouths formed after seismic shifts beneath Luclin.
Netherbian burrowers tunneled upward into the thicket.
Shadow corruption seeped into the cavern entrances.
Grimling infiltrators attempted to use the caverns but were repelled.
Vah Shir hunters reported hive-like activity deeper inside.
hooks: A new cavern mouth opens after seismic activity.
Netherbian skitterers swarm from a burrow.
A corrupted den beast emerges from the shadows.
Grimling infiltrators attempt to establish a hidden cavern camp.
